class.name: VECSComponent
class.brief_description:
A field-level accessor for one component instance attached to an entity.
一个组件实例（挂在某个实体上）的字段级访问器。
class.description:
[b]VECSComponent[/b] is a transient accessor obtained from [method VECSEntity.get_component]. Reads and writes go straight to the entity's archetype column, so every [method set_field] is reflected immediately and marks the row as changed (which feeds [code].changed()[/code] queries).
The accessor stays valid for the lifetime of the entity; after a structural change the underlying storage may move, so re-fetch the accessor if you keep it across such changes.
[b]VECSComponent[/b] 是通过 [method VECSEntity.get_component] 获取的临时访问器。读写直接落到实体的 archetype 列，因此每次 [method set_field] 都立即生效并标记该行已变更（供 [code].changed()[/code] 查询使用）。
访问器在实体存活期间有效；结构性变更后底层存储可能移动，因此若跨此类变更持有访问器，请重新获取。

method.name: field_contains
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] when the field [param name] equals [param value] (scalar fields) or when any element of a fixed-array field equals it. Replaces the "rebuild the array and scan for a 0-sentinel" idiom with one call. Comparison uses GDScript [code]==[/code] semantics, so an F32 array element matches an int [code]0[/code] and vice versa.
当字段 [param name] 等于 [param value]（标量字段）或固定数组字段的任一元素等于它时返回 [code]true[/code]。用一次调用替代"重建数组并扫描 0 哨兵"的写法。比较采用 GDScript [code]==[/code] 语义，因此 F32 数组元素可与 int [code]0[/code] 互相匹配。

method.name: get_array_element
method.description:
Reads one element of a fixed-array field ([code]count > 1[/code]). Returns a null [Variant] for scalar fields, out-of-range indices, or unknown fields.
读取固定数组字段（[code]count > 1[/code]）的单个元素。标量字段、越界下标或未知字段返回空 [Variant]。

method.name: get_bool
method.description:
Typed accessor: reads the field [param name] and returns it as a [bool]. Numeric fields coerce (non-zero is [code]true[/code]). A missing component/field returns [code]false[/code]. Lets GDScript callers drop explicit [code]bool()[/code] casts.
类型化访问器：读取字段 [param name] 并以 [bool] 返回。数字字段会强转（非零为 [code]true[/code]）。组件/字段缺失返回 [code]false[/code]。让 GDScript 调用方免去显式 [code]bool()[/code] 强转。

method.name: get_field
method.description:
Returns the value of the field [param name]. Returns [param default] (a null [Variant] by default) if the field does not exist on this component type.
返回字段 [param name] 的值。若该组件类型上没有此字段则返回 [param default]（默认是空 [Variant]）。

method.name: get_field_count
method.description:
Returns the fixed-array length of the field [param name]: [code]1[/code] for scalar fields, [code]>1[/code] for arrays, [code]0[/code] for unknown fields.
返回字段 [param name] 的固定数组长度：标量字段为 [code]1[/code]，数组为 [code]>1[/code]，未知字段为 [code]0[/code]。

method.name: get_fields
method.description:
Returns every field of this component as a [Dictionary] of name to value.
以名称到值的 [Dictionary] 形式返回该组件的所有字段。

method.name: get_float
method.description:
Typed accessor: reads the field [param name] and returns it as a [float]. Integer fields widen; bool coerces to [code]1.0[/code]/[code]0.0[/code]. A missing component/field returns [code]0.0[/code]. Lets GDScript callers drop explicit [code]float()[/code] casts.
类型化访问器：读取字段 [param name] 并以 [float] 返回。整数字段拓宽；bool 强转为 [code]1.0[/code]/[code]0.0[/code]。组件/字段缺失返回 [code]0.0[/code]。让 GDScript 调用方免去显式 [code]float()[/code] 强转。

method.name: get_int
method.description:
Typed accessor: reads the field [param name] and returns it as an [int]. Float fields truncate; bool coerces to [code]1[/code]/[code]0[/code]. A missing component/field returns [code]0[/code]. Lets GDScript callers drop explicit [code]int()[/code] casts (CHANT had 162 of these).
类型化访问器：读取字段 [param name] 并以 [int] 返回。浮点字段截断；bool 强转为 [code]1[/code]/[code]0[/code]。组件/字段缺失返回 [code]0[/code]。让 GDScript 调用方免去显式 [code]int()[/code] 强转（CHANT 有 162 处）。

method.name: get_string
method.description:
Typed accessor: reads the field [param name] and returns it as a [String]. Non-string fields are stringified like GDScript [code]str()[/code]. A missing component/field returns an empty [String]. Lets GDScript callers drop explicit [code]str()[/code] casts.
类型化访问器：读取字段 [param name] 并以 [String] 返回。非字符串字段按 GDScript [code]str()[/code] 方式字符串化。组件/字段缺失返回空 [String]。让 GDScript 调用方免去显式 [code]str()[/code] 强转。

method.name: get_type_name
method.description:
Returns the name of the component type this accessor refers to.
返回该访问器所指组件类型的名称。

method.name: get_vector
method.description:
Typed accessor: reads the field [param name] and returns it unchanged when it is a [Vector2]/[Vector2i]/[Vector3]/[Vector3i]/[Vector4]/[Vector4i]. Returns a null [Variant] for non-vector or missing fields. Lets GDScript callers drop explicit [code]Vector3()[/code] casts.
类型化访问器：当字段 [param name] 是 [Vector2]/[Vector2i]/[Vector3]/[Vector3i]/[Vector4]/[Vector4i] 时原样返回。非向量或缺失字段返回空 [Variant]。让 GDScript 调用方免去显式 [code]Vector3()[/code] 强转。

method.name: is_valid
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying entity is alive and still has this component.
若底层实体存活且仍拥有该组件则返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: set_array_element
method.description:
Writes one element of a fixed-array field and marks the row changed (field-level change event). Returns [code]false[/code] for scalar fields, out-of-range indices, unknown fields, or incompatible value types.
写入固定数组字段的单个元素并标记该行已变更（字段级变更事件）。标量字段、越界下标、未知字段或不兼容的值类型返回 [code]false[/code]。

method.name: set_field
method.description:
Writes [param value] into the field [param name] and marks the row changed. No-op if the field does not exist or the entity is dead.
把 [param value] 写入字段 [param name] 并标记该行已变更。若字段不存在或实体已销毁则为空操作。
